channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold climbs as weak US NFP sends the US Dollar to a two-week low
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades on the front foot on Thursday as the US Dollar (USD) weakens amid rumors of a potential intervention by Tokyo after the Japanese Yen (JPY) hit a 40-year low earlier this week. The Greenback extended its losses following a weaker-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report.

item.title: Euro hits a nine-day high after softer-than-expected US NFP
item.description: The Euro (EUR) gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday after weaker-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data reduced expectations of an imminent Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike.

item.title: BoE’s Mann: Activist move can bring inflation expectations and outcomes toward 2% target
item.description: Bank of England (BoE) policymaker Catherine Mann said on Thursday that an “activist move” may be needed if inflation expectations and outcomes move unfavorably, according to a speech text released by the BoE ahead of an event hosted by French bank Natixis.

item.title: Thailand: Narrow rebound, steady BoT rate – UOB
item.description: UOB economists Enrico Tanuwidjaja and Sathit Talaengsatya see Thailand’s 2Q26 starting stronger than feared, driven by exports and technology-linked investment, but with domestic demand still weak.

item.title: Central banks: Framework guidance shift reshapes analysis – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank strategist Michael Every highlights how Fed Chair Warsh and other major central bankers at Sintra are signalling a structural shift away from traditional forward guidance towards data-driven “framework guidance.” Every stresses that evolving AI, new inflation measures and reduced public tou

item.title: Mexico: USMCA review cycle extends uncertainty – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Dev Ashish argues that the US decision to opt for annual USMCA reviews instead of a 16-year extension prolongs policy uncertainty for Mexico while leaving near-term trade flows intact.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ governance and housing signals – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu reports that the RBNZ will keep its Monetary Policy Committee at six members ahead of the November election, after a split 3-3 vote in May where external members backed a hike.

item.title: Canadian Dollar gains as weaker US jobs data pressure US Dollar
item.description: USD/CAD falls to 1.4180 on Thursday, down 0.26% on the day after dropping to 1.4150, its lowest level in more than a week, following a much weaker-than-expected US employment report.

item.title: US Dollar: Softer jobs and inflation outlook weigh on rate expectations – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Bernd Weidensteiner highlights that US nonfarm payrolls rose only 57,000 in June, far below consensus, with prior months revised down by 74,000. Monthly job growth has been slowing and the six-month average is expected to turn lower.

item.title: Eurozone: Minimum reserves debate reshapes liquidity – ING
item.description: ING strategists Benjamin Schroeder and Michiel Tukker discuss how a potential increase in the Minimum Reserve Requirement (MRR) by the ECB could tighten Eurozone liquidity and reduce ECB losses.

item.title: Swiss Franc gains as disappointing US Nonfarm Payrolls pressure the US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF weakens sharply on Thursday as the US Dollar (USD) comes under broad selling pressure following a weaker-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report. At the time of writing, the pair is trading around 0.8029, its lowest level since June 18, down nearly 0.80% on the day.

item.title: Fed's Daly: There is a scenario where Fed has to fight inflation
item.description: While speaking at a Banco de España conference in Santander, Spain, San Francisco Federal Reserve President Mary Daly said that she doesn't see any signs of a lack of economic resiliency in the US, despite above-target inflation, per Reuters.

item.title: Germany: Bureaucracy cuts and tax tweaks – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Dr. Ralph Solveen reviews Germany’s new reform package agreed by CDU/CSU and SPD, focusing on bureaucracy reduction, labor market changes, and modest tax adjustments.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens after trade deficit, Japanese Yen lifted by intervention risks
item.description: AUD/JPY declines by 0.61% on Thursday, trading around 111.40 at the time of writing.

item.title: United States Initial Jobless Claims dropped to 215K last week
item.description: According to a report from the US Department of Labour (DOL) released on Thursday, the number of US citizens submitting new applications for unemployment insurance shrank to 215K for the week ending June 27.

item.title: Breaking: US Nonfarm Payrolls rise by 57K in June vs. 110K expected
item.description: Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) in the United States (US) rose by 57K in June, the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Thursday. This print followed the 129K increase (revised from 172K) recorded in May and fell short of the market expectation of 110K by a wide margin.

item.title: Euro: Labor resilience and ECB split shape outlook – BNY
item.description: BNY's Geoff Yu highlights that Sintra offered limited clarity on Euro area growth, but an emerging split within the European Central Bank (ECB) over further tightening points to easier financial conditions.

item.title: US Dollar: Near-term support with higher rate volatility – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan notes the US Dollar strengthened as lower Eurozone CPI, comments from Kevin Warsh, and anticipation of US Non-Farm Payrolls supported the currency.

item.title: Mexican Peso: Policy uncertainty caps nearshoring upside – Societe Generale
item.description: Dev Ashish at Societe Generale notes that MXN price action was relatively muted after the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) extension decision, indicating investors largely expected the outcome.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Possible Japan intervention caps gains near 216.00
item.description: GBP/JPY trades under pressure on Thursday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens across the board amid speculation that Japanese authorities may have intervened in the foreign exchange market after the Yen fell to a 40-year low against the US Dollar (USD) earlier this week.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Euro holds above 183.75 with bearish pressure mounting
item.description: The Euro (EUR) accelerated its decline against a strong Japanese Yen (JPY), which has rallied across the board on Thursday, without any clear reason to explain the move.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention uncertainty reshapes carry trades – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that iFlow data show clients turning underweight Japanese Yen (JPY) for the first time since Q4 2024, as USD/JPY’s climb and intervention fears had kept hedge ratios low.

item.title: United States Dollar Index slumps to near 101 in countdown to the US NFP data
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) underperforms its major currency peers ahead of the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for June, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar strengthens against USD on weak US data ahead NFP
item.description: NZD/USD trades higher around 0.5680 on Thursday at the time of writing, up 0.16% on the day, as investors reduce their exposure to the US Dollar (USD) ahead of the release of the US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report.

item.title: US Dollar: Constructive price action on jobs data – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that the Dollar sell-off after Kevin Warsh’s Sintra appearance has already been retraced, with markets concluding the new Fed Chair is comfortable letting data drive expectations.

item.title: Here's where Gold could head next after the WGC pencils in $5,000 as upside ceiling
item.description: Gold prices are expected to trade broadly stable in the second half of the year, seesawing within a 5% range from current levels of around $4,100 per troy ounce, according to analysts at the World Gold Council (WGC).

item.title: Euro: Downside bias builds into NFP against US Dollar – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that softer Euro-zone inflation has pushed EUR/USD below support at 1.1400, with yields falling and markets less confident of another ECB rate hike. The ECB’s “milder” scenario now looks more likely, reducing pressure to tighten further.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecasts: Nears weekly top at 1.1435 with bearish momentum easing
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades higher on Thursday against the US Dollar (USD) as traders trim USD longs ahead of the US Nonfarm Payrolls report, due later on the day.

item.title: Indian Rupee declines despite US Dollar underperforms ahead of NFP data
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) surrenders early gains and turns marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday.

item.title: British Pound surges against US Dollar ahead of US NFP data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades 0.5% higher to near 1.3340 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.
